critical_code_review_comments: Minor a11y: BulkUploadDialog emits console warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' — DialogTitle is sr-only but no DialogDescription. Non-blocking, but could be improved by adding a <DialogDescription> (visually hidden) for screen readers.
The `key={i}` used for upload rows relies on array index; safe here because removeRow re-indexes, but preview objectURLs are never revoked on removeRow → tiny memory leak. Non-blocking.
Backend endpoint accepts menu_type/category_id as query params for a multipart POST — works, but conventionally these belong in the form data. Existing design is fine, just noting.
seed_data_creation: 5 products were created during the test flow and all were deleted at end (verified no residual /api/uploads/ products remain).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk image upload feature is fully working — filename parser (backend regex in _parse_product_filename + matching JS regex in BulkUploadDialog.parseFilename) correctly extracts name+price for all tested patterns including UTF-8 (ragù), underscore separators, ' - ' hyphens with 'CHF' suffix, and no-price case. Frontend re-serializes File with edited '{name} {price}.ext' so backend re-parses corrected values before insert. All data-testids listed in the request are present and functional. Pre-existing seed product 'Tagliatelles al ragù CHF 26.50' (with pexels image_url) coexists with new upload — the way to distinguish new uploads is `image_url.startswith('/api/uploads/')`.
